body:
I was a daily DXM user for many years.  Unfortunately I became psychologically addicted and couldn't stop on my own.  Many times durring my years of abuse I tested positive for PCP while taking random drug tests from the VA.    At the time I was not on any other drugs that would have been responsible for the positive results.  I am sure they were from the DXM.
[Reported Dose: 'Bottle of Robotussin DM 8 oz']
